1967–68 Ford Mustang Steering Wheel 3-Spoke Center with Horn Pad

A recognizable first-generation Mustang interior piece for restorers seeking an original-style steering wheel center and horn pad. Verify condition and exact fitment before purchase.

1964–66 Ford Mustang OEM Radio Face Plate

Original Ford Mustang radio face plate suitable for 1964–66 cars. A useful restoration part for owners repairing or returning a modified dash toward factory appearance.

1965 Chevrolet Chevelle OEM Analog Clock

Original-style analog dash clock for the 1965 Chevelle. A desirable period interior component for restorations where factory appearance matters.

1967 Camaro Center Dash Ashtray

A center-dash ashtray for a first-generation Camaro interior restoration. Useful when replacing missing, damaged or heavily modified original dash hardware.

View on eBay
1964–65 Pontiac GTO / LeMans OEM Lower Dash Trim Bezel

Original GM lower dash trim bezel for 1964–65 Pontiac GTO and LeMans applications. A strong candidate for factory-correct interior restoration.

View on eBay
1967–72 Chevrolet / GMC C10 OEM Instrument Cluster Bezel

OEM-style instrument-cluster bezel for 1967–72 Chevrolet and GMC classic trucks. A high-visibility dash component for C10 and related truck restorations.

1964–65 Oldsmobile Cutlass / 442 / F85 OEM Dash Bezel

Used original metal dash bezel for 1964–65 Oldsmobile Cutlass, 442 and F85 models. A hard-to-find interior restoration piece with broad A-body interest.

1969 Dodge Charger Right-Side Tail Light Assembly

Used right-side tail-light assembly for a 1969 Dodge Charger. A desirable Mopar restoration piece for owners seeking original hardware and housings.

View on eBay
1963–67 Chevrolet Corvette OEM Fuel Door Emblem

Original Chevrolet Corvette fuel-door emblem for 1963–67 C2 models. A highly visible restoration detail for owners prioritizing original GM trim.

Nash Metropolitan Front Turn Signal / Parking Light Glass Lens & Bezel Set — OEM

Original used Nash Metropolitan front turn-signal/parking-light lens and bezel set. A useful restoration find when factory-style original pieces are preferred over reproductions.

1965 Ford Galaxie NOS OEM Hood Emblem “O” C5AZ-15505-F

NOS Ford hood emblem for a 1965 Galaxie. Strong restoration candidate for owners seeking original Ford trim rather than reproduction pieces; verify exact application before purchase.

1963–65 Corvette NOS GM Rear Deck Emblem #3797414

NOS GM rear deck emblem for 1963–65 Corvette, part number 3797414. A strong originality-focused restoration piece; seller notes it is new and never installed, with no hardware.

1963–64 Ford Galaxie 500 OEM Heater Control Assembly

Original FoMoCo heater control assembly with knobs, levers, and fan switch. Useful when preserving factory-correct dash controls on a 1963–64 Galaxie restoration.

1963 Ford Galaxie 500 OEM Tail Light Lens — NOS Listing

Model-specific 1963 Galaxie 500 tail-light lens offered as an OEM/NOS-type restoration find. Verify exact lens configuration and seller condition notes before purchase.

Late-Model Nash Metropolitan Grille — Used Original

Used late-model Metropolitan grille for Nash/Hudson AMC applications. A good eBay-type find when original trim is more important than buying a new reproduction.

1956–62 Nash Metropolitan OEM Exterior Door Panel Trim Set

Used OEM Metropolitan door trim for owners prioritizing original pieces over reproduction. Verify listing photos, condition, and fitment before purchase.

Original Delco 986281 AM/FM radio for a 1966 C2 Corvette. Listed for parts or repair, making it most useful as an original restoration core rather than a ready-to-install unit.
